facts.text: I am planning a birthday party for my friend.
I am looking for gift ideas for a 30-year-old woman.
I recently got a beautiful silver necklace from Tiffany's for my sister's 30th birthday.
The Tiffany's silver necklace cost around $200.
I got the Tiffany's silver necklace for my sister's 30th birthday.
I like the idea of a luxury candle or home fragrance.
My friend would like a Jo Malone candle.
My friend has been eyeing Jo Malone products for a while.
I will go with the Grapefruit candle from the Classic Collection.
I will get gift wrap with a personalized message to make the gift extra special.
I am going to get the Premium Gift Wrap with a satin ribbon and a personalized message.
I will add the message "Happy 30th Birthday, dear friend! Wishing you a year filled with love, laughter, and adventure."
